See which products and channels really make money after fees, shipping, returns and ads – and which ones quietly lose it – before you reorder, run a promotion or pay for more ads. This is a complete back office for an online shop in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first product.
Built for online sellers and small e-commerce teams – own web shop, marketplaces, social shop, wholesale and market stalls – from a few dozen products to a growing catalogue.

✓ 8 connected workbooks: products, costs and pricing; inventory and stock; purchasing and suppliers; orders, fulfilment and shipping; returns, refunds and customer service; marketing, ads and promotions; sales channels and analytics; finance, cash flow and taxes
✓ 777 ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and documents, checklists and ready WhatsApp messages

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your products, orders, stock and costs in the yellow cells, 3) margins, reorder alerts, profit and cash forecasts update by themselves. One payment, instant download.

Does it work if I sell on several channels?
Yes. It is built for selling on your own web shop, marketplaces, a social shop, wholesale and market stalls at the same time, and shows profit for each one.
Does it connect to my shop or marketplace?
No. It is a set of workbooks: you paste or type your orders, stock and costs, and every margin, alert and report updates from there. Nothing to install and no account to link.
Can I change the products, fees, tax rates and settings?
Yes. Products, suppliers, channels, carriers, fees, tax rates, thresholds and dates are all on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes.
